description: This file defines the TrackingCodeEvents class which contains static methods to handle tracking codes in a web application. The methods manage tracking code verification, creation, cookies handling, and order association within the application's tracking system.

classes.name: TrackingCodeEvents
classes.description: Contains static methods for managing tracking codes, cookies, and related tracking logic in the application.

methods.name: checkTrackingCodeUrlParam
methods.description: Checks the URL for an autoTrackingCode parameter, looks it up, and processes it if found.

methods.name: checkPartnerTrackingCodeUrlParam
methods.description: Handles partner-managed tracking codes, creating default codes if necessary, and processes them.

methods.name: processTrackingCode
methods.description: Validates and associates a tracking code with the current visit, sets cookies, session attributes, and handles redirects if configured.

methods.name: checkTrackingCodeCookies
methods.description: Inspects request cookies for tracking codes, associates them with the visit, and creates tracking code visit records.

methods.name: checkAccessTrackingCode
methods.description: Validates access tracking codes provided via request or cookies, and determines access permissions.

methods.name: removeAccesTrackingCodeCookie
methods.description: Removes access tracking code cookies from the client.

methods.name: makeTrackingCodeOrders
methods.description: Creates tracking code order entities based on cookies and request parameters for order association.
